verdict.rationale: Bolna documents a public REST API. It has a versioned /v2 endpoint catalog, API-key authentication, an API quickstart that goes from key to placed call and transcript, a live 'Try it' runner per endpoint, and multi-step workflows driven entirely through the API. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the declared openapi.yml returns 404), a stated REST deprecation/support commitment window, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Make your first Voice AI call with the Bolna API — verify your key, get an agent, place a call, and fetch the transcript in about five minutes.
The agent API surface is explicitly URL-versioned at /v2 (POST /v2/agent, GET /v2/agent/:agent_id and the rest of the v2 endpoint catalog).
Build multi-step outreach sequences that combine voice agent calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries, driven entirely through the Bolna API.
The Mintlify API reference renders a live "Try it" runner per endpoint (e.g. Create voice AI agent, POST https://api.bolna.ai/v2/agent) with generated cURL and request samples
